create_calculator: create a UMA ML potential calculator for crystal structure relaxation using a pretrained model checkpoint
get_relax_config_and_dir: generate relaxation parameters and output directory path from a workflow configuration dictionary
relax_atoms_batch: relax multiple crystal structures simultaneously using batch L-BFGS optimization with a FAIRChem calculator
relax_atoms: relax a single crystal structure using BFGS, FIRE, or L-BFGS optimizers with optional cell relaxation
run_relax_jobs: submit parallel crystal structure relaxation jobs to a SLURM cluster using submitit for GPU-accelerated processing
